brief.topic: Myth: you need an ML degree to become an AI PM
brief.audience: PMs and analysts considering a move into AI product management

coreInsight: AI PMs don't need to train models; they need to write clear eval sets, reason about the cost of errors and explain trade-offs simply.

hooks.text: You don’t need an ML degree.

What AI PM interviews actually test.

caption.opening: Moving into AI product management doesn’t start with training models.
body:
The skills that show up in the work:
→ writing a clear eval set: real inputs and what good looks like
→ reasoning about error costs: which mistakes matter and which don’t
→ explaining trade-offs simply to engineers and executives
Technical fluency helps. You build it by working with the team, not before you’re allowed in the room.
